entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.402049 +/- 0.031322 solar radii from Dressing et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-125 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....154..207D/abstract). Mass 0.494727 +/- 0.050755 solar masses from Dressing et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-125 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....154..207D/abstract). entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,654.47 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffcb94. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,654.47 K and log g 4.92 (u1 0.363, u2 0.388): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
